in_sanskrit.name: अजेन्द्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अज (aja) - not, un + इन्द्र (indra) - lord of rain, king of gods

in_marathi.name: Ajendra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ajendra is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Aje’ which means immortal or invincible, and ‘Indra’ the name of the king of gods. The name signifies a ruler or conqueror of the immortal or invincible kind.
